data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Germanic elements, Alurd means 'Exalted Counselor'. This name was borne by King Alaric I of the Visigoths, who ruled from 395 to 410 AD.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing wise guidance and exalted spiritual status.

in_hebrew.name: עלורד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עלורד הוא שם מורכב, שהוא בעצם תעתוק של השם האנגלי. אף על פי שאין השם עלורד קשור לברית החדשה או לברית הישנה, השם עלורד מורכב, ואפשרי שהוא קשור לשם האל עלי. עלי הוא סוללה דתיות, ובפרט במזרח, שם הוא ידוע כסמל לאל.

in_greek.name: Ἀλοῦρδης
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ ὄνομα Ἀλοῦρδης ὑποδείκνυται ὡς ἕνα ἀπὸ τῶν ὀνομάτων τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἀν και οὐχ ὑπάρχει ἀπευθείας ἀποδείξει, ἡ ὀνομασία Ἀλοῦρδης μάλλον ἡνωμένη ἐστὶν μετὰ τοῦ ονόματος αὐτοῦ, Ἄλλος.

in_latin.name: Alurdus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alurdus videtur esse unum ex nominibus Dei. Etiamsi non habet directam probationem, nomen Alurdus potius coniunctum est cum nomine suo, Alter.

in_english.meaning: Name of God, derived from Alter, meaning other or another
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alurd is derived from the Latin word 'alter,' which means 'other' or 'another.' As a name of God, Alurd may be associated with the concept of God as the other or the one who is beyond human comprehension. In biblical tradition, names often reflect the character or attributes of the person or deity being named. In this sense, the name Alurd may suggest a God who is beyond human categories or who exists beyond the boundaries of human understanding.
